figurative_meaning_en: This way and that; all around, sides
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়ির চারভিত্তি ফুলের বাগান লাগানো হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A flower garden has been planted all around the house.
The village is surrounded by paddy fields on all sides.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of enclosure or surrounding areas, common in rural Bengali descriptions.
